subject.title: WhatsApp: support progress drafts / outbound message edits (Baileys supports protocol edits)

question: Should WhatsApp message editing initially be an internal progress-draft transport capability, or should this work also expose a general public edit action to agents and callers?
rationale: Both are technically feasible, but a public action creates a broader channel contract and policy surface than the reported progress UX requires.

options.title: Progress-only transport
options.body: Implement editing only behind WhatsApp progress streaming, keeping the first change narrow and internal to reply delivery.

options.title: Public edit action too
options.body: Define and expose a general WhatsApp edit action with message-key inputs, capability reporting, gating, documentation, and compatibility tests.

recommendation.title: Progress-only transport
recommendation.body: Implement editing only behind WhatsApp progress streaming, keeping the first change narrow and internal to reply delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history shows the broadest ownership of WhatsApp channel architecture and plugin-boundary decisions.
